_comment: Single source of truth for the fund list. To add/remove a fund, edit ONLY this file. The script reads from this, and the skill markdown references it without listing funds inline.

_schema.name: Display name of the fund (used in Telegram alerts)
_schema.benchmark: Must be one of: nifty500, midcap150, smallcap250. Determines which score routes to this fund.
_schema.category: Free-text category label, used only for grouping in alerts.
